title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
blurb: Applied virtual-memory paging to the KV cache, nearly eliminating memory waste in LLM serving and enabling the vLLM engine's large throughput gains.
intro: Each sequence's keys and values are stored in fixed-size blocks allocated on demand from a shared pool, with a block table translating logical positions to physical blocks. That removes the over-reservation and fragmentation of contiguous allocation, lets sequences share prefix blocks with copy-on-write, and lets the scheduler batch many more requests. The steps build the block allocator, capacity planning, attention over a paged cache, prefix caching and a continuous-batching scheduler; the capstone runs a paged decode loop that appends, allocates and attends.

steps.name: Continuous batching
